This page is generated from `apps/server/internal/contentdefs/definitions/*.json`, the Widget modules in `widgets/*/tilecast.widget.json`, and the Data Source modules in `data-sources/*/tilecast.datasource.json`. It is a source reference, not a setup guide or a promise that every Player supports every item.

Use the regular Widget and Data Source guides when you need setup instructions.
